This issue tracks explicit open questions in the [wiki](https://sw-wiki.maxsp.de/parts/generator).

The quotations below preserve the scope of each source. A resource-only article can lack a formula that a separate native-code investigation has partly recovered. Reconcile those findings before treating every quoted item as wholly undecoded.

## Recorded gaps

**Practical behavior guidance**

> The shaft-link exchange and the unit of ω were not decoded; the force-weighted comparisons depend on that link.

- [wiki/data/behavior.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/behavior.json), `/families/16/limitations/1`

**Practical behavior guidance**

> Per unit of speed removed, the small, medium and large generator deposit 0.06, 2.25 and 10.625. Divided by force_emitter_max_force that is 0.06, 0.075 and 0.085, so for the same force-weighted speed removal the large generator yields 1.4167 times and the medium 1.25 times what the small one does. That comparison assumes the shaft link weights each part's speed by force_emitter_max_force, which matches how the parts write into it but was not decoded.

- [wiki/data/behavior.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/behavior.json), `/families/16/sections/1/body`

**Practical behavior guidance**

> The factor 60 between Q and Output is consistent with Output being a per-second figure at 60 updates per second, but the update rate was not recovered. Measure Output against shaft RPS per size to fix the unit of ω.

- [wiki/data/behavior.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/behavior.json), `/families/16/sections/3/body`

**Practical behavior guidance**

> Generator electric_magnitude ÷ motor electric_magnitude, valid only if both shaft links weight speed by force_emitter_max_force (not decoded); 0.85 ÷ 1.05 = 0.8095. Inputs: resource:rom/data/definitions/generator_small.xml:5528f1689692:L2-L2, resource:rom/data/definitions/generator_medium.xml:6100f8b6ac93:L2-L2, resource:rom/data/definitions/generator_large.xml:a7af79af76b2:L2-L2, resource:rom/data/definitions/motor_small.xml:77b2b5ef91f2:L2-L2, resource:rom/data/definitions/motor_medium.xml:45c0ef710323:L2-L2, resource:rom/data/definitions/motor_large.xml:9e4e7a53ba4b:L2-L2.

- [wiki/data/behavior.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/behavior.json), `/families/16/findings/19/detail`

**Definition-only extraction**

> Torque, speed, fuel use and efficiency curves are unknown. Internal configuration fields are not measured force, torque, watts or joules.

- [wiki/data/families.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/families.json), `/families/192/limitations/4`

**Definition-only extraction**

> generator_small: attributes.electric_magnitude. Component-specific charge multiplier. Recovered motor, generator and starter equations are covered by the practical behaviour research; physical units remain unresolved.

- [wiki/data/families.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/families.json), `/families/192/findings/7/detail`

- [wiki/data/families.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/families.json), `/families/192/findings/19/detail`

**Definition-only extraction**

> generator_large: attributes.electric_magnitude. Component-specific charge multiplier. Recovered motor, generator and starter equations are covered by the practical behaviour research; physical units remain unresolved.

- [wiki/data/families.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/families.json), `/families/192/findings/31/detail`

## Completion criteria

- Recover the relevant routine or run a reproducible measurement against the identified game build.
- Record equations, units, bounds, assumptions and executable addresses or measurement inputs.
- Update the wiki guidance and its extractor, retaining citations and any remaining uncertainty.
- Add or update an interactive graph when the recovered formula supports one.
- Re-run the relevant source checks and website checks.

comments.body: Partly answered in 15d8691: speed is RPS, shaft groups weight by force_emitter_max_force, the draw factor is max(0, 1 - emp/300) x pool charge fraction (see investigation/electricity.md). Still open: SI/voltage conversion and the remaining items listed on the wiki page.
